title: The woman in front of the van
situation: Waiting for friends, a 27-year-old asks officers in a van of detained protesters whether they have the paperwork; unsatisfied, she walks beside the van, then stands in front of it. The driver revs; she holds a hand on the van for about 40 minutes until the detainees are released. The photo became the movement's image.

lines.text: I knew one thing. If I had started this, I had to end it.
lines.speaker: Rhiya Ahir

lines.text: One fearless woman stood in front of a police can carrying detained protestors during Mumbai students protest
lines.speaker: X caption, @mr_mayank

lines.text: Soon more people joined and the police had to release the protestors
lines.speaker: X caption, @mr_mayank

reactionBeats: Driver revs; she flinches but stays; others join; detainees released.
